description: Use a Viewed checkbox on each file to keep track of what you've read in a long diff, synced with GitHub on the thread's pull request. Checking a file collapses and dims it, and the toolbar counts how far you have got, such as 3/6 viewed. A mark clears itself when the file's diff changes, so a rebase or a new hunk puts the file back in front of you. An Only unviewed filter hides the files you have read. Requires bb 0.41 or later, and GitHub sync needs the gh CLI signed in.
